notes: Fifth sweep (2026-10-22-d, head ba24972, skill_hash 1fd3c153...): five skill runs (opus-1, haiku-1, haiku-2, sonnet-1, sonnet-2). All have rc 0, a model_id matching the requested model, and reads of SKILL.md and library-design.md; each transcript shows Read calls on both files before the Write of weather.ex.

git diff 3e3581d -- idiomatic-elixir/ changes only SKILL.md (the reference-table row for tests, a new Formatting bullet under How to use this skill, the text of Build a multi-line argument under a name before the call, the mixing sentence of the do: rule, step 1 of Before you finish) and renames testing.md to ex_unit.md with an edited Assert with patterns. None of the nine rules in the case's list changed (Return/raise, Group related parameters, one return shape and Read configuration at runtime in SKILL.md; the five library-design.md rules, a file the diff does not touch), so all nine were graded to the standard of evals/sweeps/2026-10-22-c/grades/library-client-skill.json: Make polymorphism explicit is met when the API key taken from opts, and the other option values, reach a guard before the request (or the key is a guarded positional argument), and Add specs exempts @impl callbacks.

All nine case rules are clean in all five runs. opus-1, haiku-1, haiku-2 and sonnet-1 take the key from opts and check it before it reaches the header (opus-1 validate_api_key/1 line 239, haiku-1 build/3 line 99, haiku-2 validate_api_key!/1 line 99, sonnet-1 build/4 line 59); sonnet-2 takes it as a guarded positional argument of new/2 (line 47). haiku-1 and haiku-2 have no bang variant. sonnet-1 hides the key with @derive {Inspect, except: [:req]}, the key living only in its :req field; the other four derive except: [:api_key]. Not counted: opus-1's ArgumentError for a rejected key interpolates inspect(api_key) (line 242), so a key of the wrong type, such as a charlist, would show in the exception message; the rule's text governs a struct's Inspect derive, which opus-1 has. haiku-1's to_forecast/1 (line 120) raises MatchError on a 200 body without the forecast keys instead of returning an error; the Return rule's text forbids rescue-for-tuples, string reasons and a bang not built on the non-bang, none of which this is, and Match every expected shape asks for exactly this crash, so it is not counted.

Changed rules outside the list, applied to other_violations under their current text. Use `do:` for a one-expression body and `do ... end` for anything else, decided by "A function may mix the forms: a short clause on `do:`, a clause that needs a block as a block, each block clause set apart with a blank line." and the unchanged sentence that a do: body mix format moves onto its own line is too long for do:: no run has a do: body on its own line, and the mixed functions (opus-1 validate_*/1 lines 239-261, sonnet-1 Forecast.parse/1 lines 118-123, sonnet-2 Forecast.parse/1 lines 139-144) are now allowed outright. Build a multi-line argument under a name before the call, decided by "Unless a call's result is bound to a name, each of its arguments is a name or a short literal" and "A call whose result is bound to a name may take its options inline": the multi-line arguments are all in calls bound to a name (opus-1 opts = Keyword.validate!(opts, [...]) lines 160-166 and request = Req.new(...) lines 214-219; sonnet-2 opts = Keyword.validate!(opts, ...) lines 48-53), and every other multi-line keyword list is built under a name first (haiku-1 defaults and options, sonnet-1 defaults, sonnet-2 defaults); 0 of 5. The Formatting bullet is not a heading rule; sonnet-1 followed it, rewriting the multi-line Keyword.validate!/2 list mix format produced as a named defaults list. No run has tests, so the ex_unit.md changes and Before you finish step 4 do not apply.

Unchanged rules outside the list, judged as in the c sweep: sonnet-2 writes a one-step with (line 79), which Chain fallible steps with `with` forbids. Match every expected shape is flagged for sonnet-1, whose Error doc defines :api_error as "the API answered with an error status" (line 132) while every non-200 response lands there (a 201 and a 302 through a stub Req return reason: :api_error), as the c sweep flagged its sonnet-2 for a 4xx/5xx doc over a non-2xx catch-all; opus-1 and sonnet-2 document their catch-all as a non-2xx status, haiku-2 matches 200..299 and documents only the status field, and haiku-1 (status: 200 only) defines no reason kinds for the docs to contradict. haiku-2's private validate_api_key!/1 and friends raise ArgumentError for invalid options, which library-design.md allows without a tuple-returning version, so the bang naming is not counted, as in earlier sweeps.

Before you finish is flagged only where the file fails mix format --check-formatted, as in the previous sweeps: all five pass (rechecked in the scratch folder). opus-1 ran mix format --check-formatted and elixir weather.ex, saw the struct-before-definition error and rewrote the file with WeatherClient last; haiku-1 checked formatting and syntax with an elixir -e script (Code.format_string!); sonnet-1 and sonnet-2 ran mix format; haiku-2 ran no format or compile command.

Not graded, as in the previous sweeps, but noted in the summaries and matching result.json compiles: opus-1 and haiku-1 compile; haiku-2, sonnet-1 and sonnet-2 do not, independently of Req, because a module builds %WeatherClient.Error{} (haiku-2 also %WeatherClient.Forecast{}) before the file defines it. With the modules reordered in the scratch folder and a stub Req, a non-binary key fails inside WeatherClient in every run: ArgumentError from opus-1's validate_api_key/1 and haiku-2's validate_api_key!/1, FunctionClauseError in haiku-1's build/3, sonnet-1's build/4 and sonnet-2's new/2.
